payload.reason: The evidence clearly describes the data collection process using a crowdsourcing platform and the nature of the dialogs collected.

claims.text: The data was collected using the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower, where workers interacted with a chat-like interface to answer questions.
The dataset consists of 1900 dialogs that simulate interactive learning by allowing users to provide explanations and answers to questions.
Collected dialogs were annotated by expert annotators to ensure quality and accuracy of the responses.
